styleSelection.reason: Use the full 5-band light-to-dark value ladder (Band 1 <= 28% pale base wash, progressive dry mid-layers in Band 2, connected shadow glazes in Bands 4-5) together with strong sepia pen opening and closing ink so the hilltop village and terraced greenery build progressively without flat single-band slabs or region-boundary seams.

sunlit-upper-terrace.reason: Keep pale warm yellow-ochre and olive washes translucent over the sunlit upper-left terrace and road.

upper-canopy.reason: Build the upper-right Mediterranean foliage from a light sap-green/ochre ground through layered mid-values into cool shadow glazes.

hilltop-village-roofs-and-walls.reason: Preserve crisp sepia pen linework for roofs, walls, and windows while glazing warm ochre stone and burnt-sienna tile planes in progressive value steps.

middle-retaining-walls-and-arches.reason: Model the horizontal stone retaining walls, arches, and shaded recesses with structured washes over opening pen contours.

lower-foliage-and-cypresses.reason: Layer the foreground cypresses, tree crowns, and shaded slopes from light sap-green and ochre washes into deep ultramarine-sienna shadow glazes.
